acip: JI LTAR TE DPER NA BUM PA DANG 'KHAR GZHONG LA SOGS PA'I SNOD KYI MI 'DRA BA'I DBYE BA DU MA YOD KYANG, MI 'DRA BA'I DBYE BA DE YIS SNOD DE DAG TU GTOGS PA STE DER KHYAB PA'I NAM MKHA' LA NI, SGRIB PA THAMS CAD BKAG TZAM DU MTSUNGS PA'I PHYIR, DE LAS GZHAN PA'I DBYE BA MED PA
wylie: ji ltar te dper na bum pa dang 'khar gzhong la sogs pa'i snod kyi mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba du ma yod kyang, mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba de yis snod de dag tu gtogs pa ste der khyab pa'i nam mkha' la ni, sgrib pa thams cad bkag tsam du mtshungs pa'i phyir, de las gzhan pa'i dbye ba med pa
english: Now there are many different types of vessels, such as a water pitcher or a bronze bowl. But let's consider what is contained in all those different kinds of vessels: the empty space that overarches them all. All these empty spaces are exactly the same, in the sense that each of them is the simple absence of physical obstruction. That is, there are no other distinctions to be made here.
